title: Dīvān or Manẓūmāt (collected poetry)

date.basis: MK dates the Majlis 10196 page (f. 121b) 'early 828/1425'; that is the copying of the page. The verses' composition dates are not given, and MK says the poetry is scattered through his works.

manuscript: 4 items listed: MS Majlis 10196 f. 121b (early 828/1425); MS 5423 ff. 147b-49a (842/1439); Bāqir Riqqat majmūʿa (901/1496); MS 4029/4 (Edirne, 921/1515). Whether a full dīvān survives is unclear.
summary: Ibn Turka's poetical output appears to have been very modest; his pen name is ʿAlī; f. 121b of Majlis 10196 preserves the surviving page of ghazals, rubāʿīs and other forms, but MK's two descriptions of its contents differ.
